text: The Fed has put rate hikes back on the table for late 2026 while payrolls just went negative at -23,000 jobs — this stagflation-lite combination (rising inflation risk plus weakening employment) means you should be cautious about adding new risk right now.
NCLP.L is your most concerning large holding — down 16% overall and 29% off its high with bearish momentum signals, so consider trimming to reduce your exposure before further weakness.
META is the best value in big tech with a PE of just 16.9 and 22% revenue growth — if you have cash from selling broken positions, this is where to put some of it.
Adobe looks genuinely cheap at a PE of 9.6 with a 9.3% free cash flow yield and solid revenue growth — this is a quality business at a bargain price worth adding to on this pullback.
